explanation: This lemma is a `rfl` computation rule. It says how the library's own `CompHausAddCommGrp.homologyMap` acts on a class `QuotientAddGroup.mk x`: it sends it to the class of the library's own `kernelMap` applied to `x`. All of its content lies in definitions made inside this library (`homologyMap`, `kernelGroup`, `kernelMap`), so no Mathlib declaration can state it. I ran no search, because a definitional unfolding lemma about the library's own constructions cannot match anything in Mathlib.
